in Azj-Kahet.]] Stagshells are beetle swarmbeasts used by the nerubians. They come in a variety of colors, horns, graspers, and mandibles. Nerubian spiderlords in particular are known to summon stagshells during combat to swarm their enemies. They're also incredibly versatile; they can haul carts of supplies, they're more armored than a tank, and they have an incredible sense of smell. They're some of the only creatures that can sniff out Kaheti truffles, which the nerubians use as explosives. Even so, stagshells are some of the friendliest swarmbeasts. In Azj-Kahet, nerubians raise stagshells in swarmeries such as Rak-Ush.

State of Azeroth is a spotlight for World of Warcraft that featured upcoming updates, announcements, and creative plans as well as a roadmap for the retail and Classic flavors. This spotlight is part of the "Blizzard Showcase" series. The spotlight was hosted by Executive Producer Holly Longdale and Senior Game Director Ion Hazzikostas and held on 29 January 2026 9:00 am PST (17:00 UTC), streaming via [https://www.twitch.tv/warcraft Twitch] and [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pkFMkdZWxdk YouTube]. * * *
